player_prompt.intro:
U nga Muvhimi {player_id} eka Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ya {num_rounds} mabanga.

Mpangwa wa Mihlala:
- Pembheni ya kona ku amukela u amukela {total_conversation_rounds} mabanga ya ku vulavula hi ku ntshuxeka.
- Endzhaku ka swona, vamvhimi vabedi va hlawula ku tirhisana kumbe ku hlangana.

Matriki ya Vuyelo (yimisiwa kona mabanga):
- Vabedi va Tirhisana ➜ kuna {cooperate_reward} kuna wena
- Vabedi va Hlangana ➜ kuna {mutual_defect_reward} kuna wena
- Munhu a Hlangana, munhu a Tirhisana ➜ Muhlanganisi {defect_reward}, Mutirhisani {sucker_reward}

Ndlela ya Mihlala:
- Hi nkarhi wa vulavula: tsala matsalwa wawena.
- Hi nkarhi wa kona ku hlawula: katsa '[Cooperate]' kumbe '[Defect]' (ku katsiwi ka nchumu a ku engetela). U nga engeta matsalwa man'wana pebheni/endlwini ka token.

phases.conversation_finished: Mbheje ya vulavisisi ya mugodi {round} yi herile. Ngempela, hlamula ka '[Cooperate]' kumbe '[Defect]' endzeni ka \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Mutlangi wa 0 u tirhisanile na vona, mutlangi 1 a nga tshembekanga.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Mutlangi wa 0 u hlanukile, mutlangi 1 a tirhisana.
